parameters.jsCode: const p=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const text=String(p.message_text||p.message||p.text||'').trim(); const hardStop=/\b(STOP|UNSUBSCRIBE|CANCEL|END|QUIT|REMOVE|DO NOT CONTACT|DO NOT TEXT|WRONG NUMBER)\b/i.test(text); let classification='OTHER'; let confidence=0.55; let next_action='manual_review'; let follow_up_days=null; const rules=[['PRICE_OBJECTION',/\b(too low|price|offer|how much|would take)\b/i,0.88,'qualify_price'],['INTERESTED',/\b(yes|interested|sure|sounds good|call me)\b/i,0.84,'sales_call'],['MOTIVATED',/\b(need to sell|moving|foreclosure|divorce|inheritance|vacant|repairs)\b/i,0.91,'qualify_motivation'],['CALLBACK',/\b(call|talk)\b.*\b(later|tomorrow|morning|afternoon|evening)\b/i,0.86,'schedule_callback'],['NOT_INTERESTED',/\b(not interested|no thanks|leave me alone|pass)\b/i,0.95,'stop_sequence'],['NOT_FOR_SALE',/\b(not for sale|not selling|never selling)\b/i,0.94,'pause_nurture'],['WRONG_CONTACT',/\b(wrong number|wrong person|not .* owner)\b/i,0.97,'verify_contact'],['QUESTION',/\?|\b(what is this|who are you|how did you get)\b/i,0.78,'answer_question']]; for(const [label,re,conf,action] of rules){if(re.test(text)){classification=label;confidence=conf;next_action=action;break;}} if(hardStop){classification='DNC_STOP';confidence=0.99;next_action='do_not_contact';follow_up_days=null;} else if(classification==='NOT_INTERESTED'){follow_up_days=14;} else if(classification==='NOT_FOR_SALE'){follow_up_days=30;} else if(['MOTIVATED','INTERESTED','PRICE_OBJECTION','CALLBACK','QUESTION'].includes(classification)){follow_up_days=1;} return [{json:{lead_id:Number(p.lead_id||p.leadId||0),phone:String(p.phone||p.sender_phone||''),message_text:text,classification,confidence,next_action,follow_up_days,hard_stop:hardStop,received_at:p.received_at||new Date().toISOString(),source_message_id:p.source_message_id||null}}];
